removed: all handcrafted inputs and auxiliary prediction branches
retained: original M8 1->12 kernel9 stride4 /12->24 kernel7 stride4 CNN
per-window mean/population SD floor1e-6 and clip8
full-patient float64 population Z with original SD>1e-8 convention
96->64 GELU ->1 head with zero final output initialization
logit: standalone NEZ logit=tanh(head(PR(raw_summary96))); no D1 logit, no physiology conditioning; do not remove the tanh cap after looking at outcomes
initialization: Scratch CNN/head initial states exactly match each fold's original M8 factory; no trained Raw/D1/M8 weights used as model input or initialization. Original factory is constructed only to recover identical initialization RNG and verify identity-gate feature parity, then base/gate are discarded.
loss: Original M8 objective: 0.75 FIT-only NEZ-positive weighted BCE +0.25 patient soft Macro-F1; one equal-patient optimizer update per FIT patient
precision: Original M8 FP32; no AMP, TF32 off, cuDNN retained; chunk4096
selection: Exact original M8 validation patient Macro-F1, EZ-F1, earlier epoch; original validation-only NEZ threshold grid/tie rules. Report EZ score=1-sigmoid(NEZ logit), EZ prediction=(pNEZ<threshold).
data: Existing hash-bound raw250 /500sample banks, exact original masks, pre-reference, temporal coverage, canonical channels and five FIT/validation/Outer splits. Encode all valid windows as M8; only pre-onset reference and original0-20s summaries enter the readout, as in M8. No new extraction or sampling.
outer: Freeze all five new checkpoints and thresholds before one sealed Outer pass; no test-driven model/threshold changes. Reuse existing frozen D1 and full-M8 score ledgers only for matched reference comparison, not new inference or tuning.
privacy: Only source/hashes/anonymous aggregates. Keep raw, identities, weights, caches, individual predictions and logs private. Do not modify parent experiments or unrelated jobs.
